en: The demon breaks down the door and you begin to recite the incantation. The room's temperature rises, your body becomes soaked in sweat as you continue reading.
Do you really think empty words can hold me back??? I AM AZAZEL, PRINCE OF HELL, you are NOTHING at my feet.

While he speaks, you can perceive your grandparents repeating the same words as you from inside the Eggwatch. Even while crying, you don't stop reading. The demon lets out a loud scream, leaps towards you, entering the circle, and a bright light blinds you once more.

Your grandparents are back, the demon has vanished, and you are greeted with a warm embrace, as if you had woken from a terrible nightmare. Later that day, you discover that your family comes from a lineage of exorcists.
